lock_policy: Dated official pick files are append-only. Re-running the engine for the same date reuses the existing dated file instead of changing official picks.
note: Official records are separated by market. Moneylines use the 72% probability and 8.0/10 Lab gates; game totals are currently paused while the totals setup rating is rebuilt (see EXP-20260727-01); pitcher Ks use a 0.7-K edge, posted price, two-book coverage, and a confirmed non-opener workload.

labScoreBreakdown.note: Lab Rating grades LyDia's analysis quality only. It contains no market or price input.

pick_team.label: High risk
pick_team.workload_read: Heavy recent workload. Late-game pitching condition could materially affect the read.
pick_team.score_reason: High risk (8.8/10): 15.3 recent relief innings, recency-weighted — 6 in the last game (pitched yesterday), 4 arms worked back-to-back days. Recent innings count more; rest days lower the score. Workload only — see efficiency for how well the pen has pitched.
pick_team.formula: 45 + (recency-weighted (BP IP - 3/game) x 4.2) + (recency-weighted back-to-back arms x 8). Each game decays by half every 2 days, so rest days lower the score.

context_only.note: Reliever counts are displayed for context only and do not add score points.

pick_team.efficiency_reason: Effective (5.6/10): 3.52 ERA and 1.17 WHIP over 15.3 relief innings (6 ER, 13 H, 5 BB) in the last three days.
pick_team.efficiency_formula: 50 - clamp((ERA - 4.20) x 6, -25, 25) x confidence - clamp((WHIP - 1.30) x 15, -20, 20) x confidence, confidence = clamp(BP IP / 6, 0.35, 1)
